It doesn't provide a new definition, and we already have the association between "reading-flow-ordered scope owner" and "reading flow container" in the definition of "reading-flow-ordered scope owner" itself. Maybe this should be something like: ```

Every reading-flow-ordered scope owner has an associated reading flow container, which is a reading flow container, computed as follows: - If the associated reading-flow-ordered scope owner is a reading flow container, then return the reading-flow-ordered scope owner. - Otherwise, return the associated reading-flow-ordered scope owner's CSS parent box ``` Basically that way we're catering to each possible value that a scope owner might be, and explicitly computing its container element based on that value. I guess one question I have regarding this is: is "CSS parent box" I think so, but want to confirm.
